overall_note: Minimum persona score (privacy_legal). All 61 scripted persona tasks pass at 1440x900 and 390x844 with no JS errors, and the layout follows the wireframe (rail, sidebar, tabs, main, right bar, bottom bar; on phone the rail becomes a bottom nav and the sidebar and right bar become drawers). Scores are held down by state that goes stale after an action, roles that do not exist, and a savings story a controller would reject.

defects.issue: As Agent (Maya R.), Daniel Kim's ticket says 'Needs your approval: $112 is over the $100 limit', but the same 'Create replacement #4021-R ($112) and send' button works directly, so the agent can approve their own over-limit replacement. The guardrail is only text.
defects.fix: For roles below lead, replace the primary action with 'Request approval from Jordan P.' (and show a pending-approval state), or show who approves and log the approval in the thread.

defects.issue: After the replacement is created, the order card still shows 'Send replacement...' and 'Refund...' for #4021, which invites a duplicate replacement.
defects.fix: Once #4021-R exists, disable 'Send replacement' with the note 'Replacement #4021-R already created', and show the refund as an alternative only with a warning.

defects.issue: 'Export or delete this customer's data...' is visible and usable for the Agent role (and for Sales).
defects.fix: Hide privacy actions for Agent and Sales, or turn them into 'Request deletion (sent to privacy owner)'.

defects.issue: Suggested macros pad out with unrelated items: a cancel-subscription ticket suggests 'Wrong item: replacement (general)' and 'Damaged: replacement (general)'.
defects.fix: Show only macros that match the intent, and a 'Browse all macros' link when there are fewer than 3.

defects.issue: Grace Park has been 'Customer since Jan 2025' on a '2 bags monthly' subscription but shows '2 orders · $58 lifetime'. That cannot be right for roughly 22 months of a monthly plan.
defects.fix: Make the order count and lifetime value match the subscription history (for example '22 orders · $638'), or make her a recent subscriber.

defects.issue: After Daniel's ticket is sent and set to Pending, it stays in 'Needs a human (AI handed off)' and the view still counts 4.
defects.fix: Drop handled tickets from the Needs-human view (or mark them 'Handled · pending') and update the count.

defects.issue: The SLA summary says '94% met (47 of 50 first replies) · 4 breaches today (1 still open)'. 50 - 47 = 3, so the reader has to work out that the open breach is not in the 50.
defects.fix: Write '3 missed + 1 open breach = 4 breaches today', or count the open one in the denominator.

defects.issue: Opening a breach from Notifications switches the lead's list from 'SLA at risk or breached (5)' to 'All open (9)', so the lead loses their working view.
defects.fix: Keep the current view when the opened ticket is in it. Otherwise switch with a 'Back to SLA view' chip.

defects.issue: There is no coaching support beyond CSAT per agent. The persona cares about coaching and weekly 1:1s, but the lead cannot see QA scores, reopen rate or the AI-override rate per agent.
defects.fix: In SLA & workload, add per-agent QA score, reopen % and median first response, each linked to sample conversations for 1:1s.

defects.issue: Over-limit approvals (such as Daniel's $112 replacement) are not routed to the lead. Nothing in Notifications or the SLA view shows pending approvals.
defects.fix: Add an 'Approvals waiting (n)' item to Notifications and to the lead's sidebar.

defects.issue: The Email channel option reads 'Email (4 · 0 unread · 5 waiting >1h)': more conversations are waiting than are in the channel.
defects.fix: Count waiting conversations from the same set (or explain that the Sales inbox is included) so the waiting count can never be higher than the conversation count.

defects.issue: The headline 'Est. savings vs staying on Zendesk $2,047–2,929' (and '$4,384–5,776 per month from December') assumes Zendesk AI would have been bought and would have resolved 1,764 conversations. Billing shows the company actually paid Zendesk $9,200 for Jan–Nov (about $836/month). A board would compare the claim with that number at once.
defects.fix: Lead with savings against actual Zendesk spend (about $836 → $599/month), and show 'vs Zendesk with AI at your volume' as a second, clearly hypothetical line.

defects.issue: 'Weekly volume and CSAT, 12 weeks' has no volume axis or values. Only some bars carry CSAT labels, so volume growth cannot be read.
defects.fix: Add a y-axis or a volume value on each bar, and label CSAT on every week, or draw it as a line on a second axis.

defects.issue: There is no Head of CX role in 'View as'. The persona has to use Owner (Hana O.), who also sees Billing and Admin actions.
defects.fix: Add a 'Head of CX' role (Reports, AI agent, Migration, read-only Billing summary).

defects.issue: On 'Overview for the board', the right bar shows live queue filters and five SLA tickets with Reassign buttons, which is operational noise for a board view.
defects.fix: Make the right bar follow the sub-page: for Overview show definitions, the export and the period comparison (vs previous period or vs Zendesk weeks).

defects.issue: No KPI is compared with a previous period (no delta vs October on Zendesk, for example), so the 'story for the board' has to be assembled by hand.
defects.fix: Add '+/- vs Oct (Zendesk)' deltas to the CSAT, first-response and cost KPIs.

defects.issue: The 12-month projection shows 'Zendesk for comparison: $59,790–76,500', but Budget vs actual on the same screen shows Zendesk actually cost $9,200 for 11 months. A controller will reject the comparison as inflated.
defects.fix: Show three lines: actual Zendesk run rate (about $10k/yr), Zendesk at renewal price including the seat increase, and 'Zendesk + AI at your volume' (hypothetical). Base the headline on the first two.

defects.issue: The fair-use rule is soft: 'if you're above it 3 months in a row we'll talk about Flat 25. Nothing changes without your OK.' It does not say what happens if the customer says no.
defects.fix: State the rule as a contract term: 'Above 3,000 for 3 consecutive months: either stay on Flat 10 with AI throttled to X/day, or move to Flat 25. No back-billing.' Link the clause in Terms.

defects.issue: The projection runs Dec 2026–Nov 2027, but the price is locked only until Oct 31, 2027. The price assumed for Nov 2027 is not stated.
defects.fix: Note 'Nov 2027 assumes list price; renewal cap X%', or end the projection at the lock date.

defects.issue: The transition-month Zendesk cost is shown at 'list price, not your contract' even though the actual Zendesk spend is in Budget vs actual, so the two Zendesk numbers disagree on the same page.
defects.fix: Pre-fill the transition line from the actual Zendesk amount for November, or reconcile the two numbers.

defects.issue: There is no invoice-level breakdown of seats used vs paid, and no alert before a seat change crosses into the next tier (after the BPO group is added, usage is 10/10 and the next hire costs +$400/month).
defects.fix: Add a 'Next tier at agent 11: +$400/mo' warning to Billing and a notification to Finance when seats reach 9/10 or 10/10.

defects.issue: The Migration summary hides the proof numbers. '48,210 of 48,210 tickets · 112,904 attachments' only appears inside the Tickets step.
defects.fix: Put the counts on the summary's 'Proof history arrived' card next to the spot-check.

defects.issue: Revenue impact is one number ('$480 in open conversations'). Nothing shows repeat purchases or sales lost to slow replies, which are the founder's stated outcomes.
defects.fix: Add 'Orders placed within 7 days of a support reply' and 'Revenue saved by pause offers and replacements' to the board overview.

defects.issue: The savings figures in the bottom bar ('Est. saved vs Zendesk, Nov: ~$2,047–2,929') depend on the hypothetical Zendesk AI cost (see finance), which a founder may repeat to investors.
defects.fix: Use savings against actual spend in the bottom bar.

defects.issue: The header says 'Status: complete' while the peak-readiness card has an open To-do, so 'complete' reads as 'nothing left'.
defects.fix: Say 'Migration complete · 1 peak item open'.

defects.issue: The audit log is a short list in the right bar, with no filter, search or export (for example to a SIEM) and no retention period. IT needs it as evidence.
defects.fix: Add an Audit log page under Admin with filters (actor, action, date), CSV export, a SIEM/webhook stream and a stated retention.

defects.issue: Only SOC 2 Type I is available ('Type II audit in progress'), with no date. Security questionnaires will flag this.
defects.fix: Give the expected Type II report date and offer a bridge letter.

defects.issue: There are no session or network controls beyond '12h sessions': no IP allowlist and no session revocation for a user (relevant to Sam T.'s blocked sign-in).
defects.fix: Add an IP allowlist and per-user 'Sign out everywhere' to Security.

defects.issue: The IT role can open 'Rules & AI guardrails' and change AI behaviour. That is support ops' area, so it is a separation-of-duties concern.
defects.fix: Make Rules read-only for IT, or let only Admin and Owner edit them.

defects.issue: After the agent replies to Lucía on WhatsApp, the header shows '24h window: 24h 0m left'. WhatsApp's window restarts on the customer's last message, not on a business reply, so the window should still show about 22h 52m left. An ops manager who knows the rule will distrust the timer.
defects.fix: Calculate the window only from the customer's last inbound message.

defects.issue: The channel view select is cut off at desktop width ('Channel: WhatsApp (2 · 1 unre').
defects.fix: Shorten the option label ('WhatsApp (2)') and keep the stats in the chips below, or widen the select or let it wrap.

defects.issue: The approved template is shown with raw placeholders ('Hi {{name}}, ... {{order}}: {{status}}') and no filled-in preview.
defects.fix: Render a preview with Alex Morgan / #4020 / 'no scan since Nov 15' before 'Send template'.

defects.issue: There is no WhatsApp/Ops role in 'View as', so the persona runs as Owner.
defects.fix: Add a WhatsApp/Ops role scoped to the WhatsApp and Spanish group inboxes.

defects.issue: Alex Morgan's list time ('23h 0m ago') matches no message (the last agent message was at 11:20 and read at 11:31 on Nov 18).
defects.fix: Base the list time on the last message.

defects.issue: With 'Last 7 days · Nov 13–19' selected, the Puerto Rico gap's sample conversations include 'Luis R. · Nov 11', which is outside the period.
defects.fix: Filter the right-bar samples to the selected period, or label them 'all time'.

defects.issue: After an article is published, the sidebar still says '17 gaps / 18 gaps' and the published gap stays in 'Questions the AI couldn't answer'.
defects.fix: Move published gaps to a 'Fixed this period' group and decrease the open gap count.

defects.issue: The 'Help-centre self-serve rate 76%' is article views against conversations, a vanity metric (a view does not mean the question was answered).
defects.fix: Use sessions that viewed an article and did not open a conversation within 24h, and state the definition.

defects.issue: After publishing the Puerto Rico article, nothing prompts a reply to the open ticket from Tom Rivera, who asked that exact question.
defects.fix: After publishing, offer 'Reply to 1 open conversation with this article'.

defects.issue: There is no Knowledge role in 'View as'.
defects.fix: Add a Knowledge manager role (AI agent tab and article editing).

defects.issue: 'Auto-close solved after 4 days' is mapped to 'Auto-resolve pending after 4 days' and marked as a green 'Mapped', but the meaning changed (solved→closed became pending→resolved).
defects.fix: Mark it 'Mapped with changes' and explain the difference, as is done for the VIP rule.

defects.issue: After the guardrail changes to $150, Daniel Kim's open $112 ticket still says 'Needs your approval: $112 is over the $100 limit'.
defects.fix: Re-evaluate the policy check on open conversations ('Under the new $150 limit; AI could now handle this') or state that the old rule still applies to tickets opened before the change.

defects.issue: The 'View as' select in the bottom bar is cut off at 1440px ('Support ops admin · Nin').
defects.fix: Give the select enough width or a shorter label.

defects.issue: SLA policies give hours but not whether they are business or calendar hours, and nothing about holiday calendars, which matters for Black Friday.
defects.fix: Show business hours and the calendar on each SLA policy.

defects.issue: Only 7 triggers are listed, with no total ('7 of 7 migrated'?), no mapping for views or automations, and no way to test a trigger.
defects.fix: Show migrated counts per object type (triggers, automations, views, macros) and add 'Test on sample ticket' for each trigger.

defects.issue: The scorecard lists 4 criteria (correct, promised only what was done, on brand, right language), but scoring is a single Good / Needs fix.
defects.fix: Score each criterion (pass/fail or 1–3) and roll up a QA score per AI and per agent.

defects.issue: Only AI replies can be sampled. The persona reviews human agents too and runs onboarding.
defects.fix: Add a 'Human replies' sample and per-agent feedback that the lead can use in 1:1s.

defects.issue: Saving the correction for Mei Chen updates the AI's knowledge, but the customer who was promised a change that cannot happen is never told.
defects.fix: After 'Needs fix', offer 'Reopen and send corrected reply to Mei Chen'.

defects.issue: The 5-reply sample shows no running totals (pass rate this month, trend), so a coach cannot report quality.
defects.fix: Add the AI QA pass rate for the period, with n, to the QA sidebar and to Reports.

defects.issue: There is no QA role in 'View as'.
defects.fix: Add a QA/training role.

defects.issue: After 'Deletion scheduled for Daniel Kim ... 2 conversations, AI logs and CSAT answers deleted now', Daniel's conversation, email, messages and order card stay fully visible in the inbox. The screen contradicts the confirmation.
defects.fix: After confirmation, remove or redact the customer (for example 'Deleted customer · request #DSR-012') from the list, thread and right bar.

defects.issue: The wording conflicts: the title says 'Deletion scheduled' and the body says 'deleted now', with purge from backups by Dec 24.
defects.fix: Use one state with dates: 'Deleted from FlatDesk Nov 19 · purged from backups by Dec 24'.

defects.issue: There is no DSAR register: no list of requests with received date, statutory due date (30/45 days), identity verification or requester, only a single audit-log line.
defects.fix: Add Admin › Privacy requests listing each access or deletion request with source, verification step, due date and status.

defects.issue: Deletion can be triggered on an open ticket with a pending replacement, with no warning, and by any role including Agent and Sales.
defects.fix: Restrict deletion to Owner, Admin or a Privacy role. Warn about open conversations and pending orders before confirming.

defects.issue: Retention is 'kept until you delete them', with no configurable automatic retention period. Data is in us-east-1 for EU customers (French, Spanish) with no transfer mechanism (SCCs) stated.
defects.fix: Add a retention setting (for example auto-delete after 24 months) and state the SCC/DPF transfer basis in the DPA card.

defects.issue: The toast reads 'Downloading Signed DPA (mock)', and the audit log mixes 'Downloaded Signed DPA' and 'Downloaded DPA (signed copy)'.
defects.fix: Remove '(mock)' and use one document name.

defects.issue: Sales (Carla M.) gets a notification badge of 5 for support SLA breaches she cannot see or act on (Jean Dupont, Omar Haddad, and others).
defects.fix: Scope notifications to the role's inboxes: Carla should see only the Ben Carter lead.

defects.issue: The 'Lead synced to CRM' event does not name the CRM, link to the record, or show the deal value or stage.
defects.fix: Show 'HubSpot deal #123 · Carter's Corner Café · est. $X/mo (15 kg) · stage: New' with a link.

defects.issue: Suggested macros for a wholesale lead include 'Wrong item: replacement (general)' and 'Damaged: replacement (general)'.
defects.fix: Show only sales macros (intro, samples, call booking).

defects.issue: The text '1 conversations' is ungrammatical, and the bottom bar shows irrelevant agent-seat and AI fair-use counters to Sales.
defects.fix: Handle singular/plural, and hide billing counters for roles without Billing.

defects.issue: Contact reasons have counts and share but no trend against the previous period, although the persona expects 'reasons with trends'.
defects.fix: Add a 'vs previous period' delta column and a small trend line per reason.

defects.issue: Reason rows cannot be clicked, so the marketer cannot read the cancel or complaint conversations behind a number.
defects.fix: Link each reason to a filtered list of its conversations, with export to the email/SMS tool for win-back.

defects.issue: '$783/month of subscriptions kept (at $29)' values every save at $29, though subscriptions vary (Mei Chen pays $18).
defects.fix: Sum the actual subscription prices of saved customers.

defects.issue: The right bar on Contact reasons shows live queue filters and SLA tickets with Reassign buttons, which have nothing to do with this page.
defects.fix: Show reason definitions, period comparison and saved-customer list here instead.

defects.issue: Grace Park's AI draft pauses her subscription until Feb 1 although she only asked how to cancel or pause. The action goes beyond what the customer asked for.
defects.fix: Have the draft offer the pause and ask for confirmation, or make 'Pause until Feb 1' an explicit choice in the composer.

defects.issue: Instagram DM sentiment and reviews, which the persona cares about, do not appear anywhere.
defects.fix: Add a sentiment-by-channel card (Instagram), with examples.

defects.issue: Issues are raw counts ('8 fulfilment issues') with no rate per orders shipped, so the reader cannot tell whether HOUSE-1KG with 3 issues is a problem.
defects.fix: Show issue rate per 1,000 orders shipped by SKU and carrier, with the previous period.

defects.issue: Mis-picks (wrong grind or wrong item, a warehouse fault) and carrier damage are mixed together with no owner.
defects.fix: Group by fault owner (warehouse vs carrier) and add 'Send to 3PL' or 'File carrier claim' bulk actions.

defects.issue: The right bar on Fulfilment issues shows the support SLA queue, which is irrelevant here.
defects.fix: Show the weekly digest preview, recipients and an export button.

defects.issue: There is no Fulfilment role, and opening an issue jumps to Conversation with no way back to the list.
defects.fix: Add a Fulfilment role (Reports › Fulfilment plus read-only conversations) and a 'Back to Fulfilment issues' breadcrumb.

defects.issue: There is no reporting for the Overflow group: the BPO cannot see its own contracted SLA attainment, volume or CSAT.
defects.fix: Add the Overflow group as a filter in Reports › SLA & workload, with a shareable vendor SLA report.

defects.issue: The create form shows '7 → 10 of 10' but does not warn that the next hire moves the plan to Flat 25 (+$400/month).
defects.fix: Show 'You'll be at 10/10; agent 11 moves you to Flat 25 ($999)' in the form.

defects.issue: There is no BPO or vendor-manager role, so the persona sees everything as Owner. Outsourced agents need a restricted role with no Reports or Billing.
defects.fix: Add a 'Vendor manager (ShiftCX)' role limited to the Overflow group's conversations and reports.

defects.issue: 'Hours 18:00–08:00 ET' is free text, with no handling of time zones or holiday cover for Black Friday and Cyber Monday.
defects.fix: Use a schedule picker with time zone and holiday overrides.

global_defects.issue: 8 of 15 personas (head_cx, ops_whatsapp, knowledge, qa_coach, privacy_legal, retention_marketing, fulfillment_ops, bpo_manager) have no 'View as' role and run as Owner with every tab and destructive action, so role-appropriate scoping cannot be checked for them.
global_defects.fix: Add roles for Head of CX, Knowledge, QA, Privacy, Marketing, Fulfilment, BPO/Vendor and WhatsApp ops, each with scoped tabs, start page, notifications and permissions.

global_defects.issue: The savings shown in the bottom bar, Reports and Billing compare against a hypothetical 'Zendesk + AI at your volume', while Billing shows actual Zendesk spend of about $836/month. This is the biggest trust risk for a buyer leaving Zendesk.
global_defects.fix: Make actual Zendesk spend (and the renewal quote) the primary baseline everywhere, and the Zendesk-AI figure a clearly labelled secondary scenario.

global_defects.issue: The Reports right bar is the same on every sub-page (live queue filters plus SLA-at-risk tickets), even on Contact reasons, Fulfilment and the board overview.
global_defects.fix: Give each sub-page its own right-bar content. Keep the live SLA list for SLA & workload only.

global_defects.issue: Suggested macros always pad to 3 with unrelated 'Wrong item / Damaged (general)' entries.
global_defects.fix: Show only macros relevant to the intent.

global_defects.issue: Phone (390px): the 'Sections'/'Inbox' drawer button covers the scrolled tab strip ('Conversation' shows as 'ation', 'Reports' as 'Repor'), and nothing signals that more tabs exist.
global_defects.fix: Put the drawer button outside the scrolling tab strip with its own space, and add fade edges or a 'More' overflow menu.

global_defects.issue: Toasts persist across tab changes and on phone sit over the 'View as' bar.
global_defects.fix: Dismiss toasts on navigation, and on phone place them above the bottom nav and View-as bar.

global_defects.issue: Selects are cut off at 1440px (the channel view select and the 'View as' select).
global_defects.fix: Shorten the labels, or let the controls size to their content.

global_defects.issue: Channel counts do not reconcile: 'Email (4 · 0 unread · 5 waiting >1h)'.
global_defects.fix: Calculate the waiting count from the same conversation set.

global_defects.issue: Policy and window text goes stale after a change: the $100 limit still shows after the change to $150, the WhatsApp window resets on an outbound message, and a deleted customer stays visible.
global_defects.fix: Recompute derived state (policy check, window, privacy state) from the current rules and data on every render.

global_defects.issue: The dark-mode contrast scan found no failures and the phone target-size scan found no target under 24px. However, in dark mode the primary buttons (light lavender) look almost the same as disabled buttons such as the greyed 'Draft article'.
global_defects.fix: Make disabled states clearly different (lower opacity plus a not-allowed cursor plus a text reason).

missing_personas.cares_about: Contract terms that avoid another renewal trap: price caps, exit rights, uptime SLA with credits, vendor risk.
missing_personas.time_spent: Reviewing order forms, negotiating renewals, tracking contract dates and vendor risk files.
missing_personas.struggles: Zendesk auto-renewed annually with a seat increase; uptime and support commitments are buried in long MSAs.
missing_personas.how_helps: A Contract page with the signed order form, renewal date and cap, notice deadline reminders, uptime SLA with credit history and status page, and exit/data-return terms.

tasks.name: Find the renewal date, price cap after Oct 31 2027, uptime SLA and credits, and set a notice reminder

missing_personas.cares_about: Reliable integrations (Shopify, Slack, CRM, 3PL), webhooks and API limits; nothing breaks silently after the migration.
missing_personas.time_spent: Maintaining webhooks, API scripts and app integrations; debugging failed syncs.
missing_personas.struggles: Zendesk apps did not carry over (the Slack angry-customer alert needs review); no visibility into failed webhook deliveries.
missing_personas.how_helps: An Integrations page with each connected app's health, webhook builder with test payloads and delivery log, API keys with scopes and rate limits.

tasks.name: Replace the unmapped 'Slack alert on angry customer' trigger with a webhook, send a test payload and see the delivery log

missing_personas.cares_about: Product defects and confusing product information that drive contacts and returns; roadmap input from customers.
missing_personas.time_spent: Reviewing returns, reviews and feedback; updating product pages and packaging.
missing_personas.struggles: Product questions (12% of contacts) and complaints like 'decaf Swiss Water?' are buried in tickets and never reach product owners.
missing_personas.how_helps: A product-feedback report by SKU (questions, defects, return reasons) with example quotes, trends and a link to fix the product page or packaging.

tasks.name: See the top SKUs by product questions and defects this period, open example conversations and flag the decaf page conflict

missing_personas.cares_about: Right staffing per hour across channels and time zones, especially for Black Friday and Cyber Monday.
missing_personas.time_spent: Building shift schedules, forecasting by hour, managing time-off and BPO overflow.
missing_personas.struggles: The forecast is weekly only; no intraday arrivals by channel; shift coverage and the AI's share are not modelled together.
missing_personas.how_helps: An hourly forecast by channel after AI deflection, coverage against scheduled shifts (including Overflow), with gaps highlighted.

tasks.name: Open the Black Friday week's hourly forecast for chat and email after AI and see uncovered hours against the schedule
